_comment: The brand-prompt compiler. The Generate panel never sends a raw user prompt to the model — it compiles [trigger] + [subject] + [house look] + [realism] + [surface context] and applies the negative + the safety blocklist. Tune the tokens here; they should DESCRIBE the Medartis library, not fight it.
_trigger_note: The LoRA trigger word. Only used when a Medartis LoRA is present in ComfyUI; harmless otherwise.
look: editorial photograph in the Medartis house style
precision-engineering environment, clean modern manufacturing and training space
cool neutral daylight, soft directional key, gentle falloff, controlled specular highlights
coal black, bone white, warm brushed metal and muted gold palette
restrained composition, generous negative space, calm, exact, understated
real hands, real practitioners, documentary rather than staged
shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, matte surfaces, no gloss
_realism_note: REALISM IS MOSTLY A POSITIVE-PROMPT PROBLEM. FLUX.1 [dev] is guidance-distilled: at CFG 1 it does not read a negative prompt at all, so photorealism has to be ASSERTED here rather than merely forbidden below. These tokens are appended whenever realism is on.
realism: photorealistic, indistinguishable from a real photograph
shot on a full-frame DSLR, 50mm prime lens at f/2.0, natural depth of field
physically accurate light transport, believable soft shadows and contact shadows
true-to-life skin texture with visible pores and fine imperfections
authentic material response: micro-scratches on metal, real fabric weave, dust in the air
natural colour science, neutral white balance, unretouched
subtle sensor noise and fine film grain, slight optical vignetting
candid unposed moment, imperfect natural framing

surfaces.dark: composed for a coal-black layout, darker mid-tones, room for type in the upper third
surfaces.light: composed for a bone-white layout, airy high-key, room for type in the upper third
surfaces.overlay: wide establishing framing with an empty lower third for a text overlay

programs.product: surgical instruments and implant systems on a clean workbench, macro precision
programs.manufacturing: precision manufacturing floor, CNC and metrology, quiet focus
programs.training: hands-on training laboratory, instruments and workstations
programs.congress: congress hall, booth, conversation between colleagues
programs.corporate: modern office and laboratory interiors, architectural calm

_negative_note: Grouped by the failure mode each line kills. Order matters little; coverage does. This is honoured by SDXL / SDXL-Turbo, and by Flux ONLY when 'strict negatives' raises CFG above 1 (slower). The server reports which engine actually consumed it, so the panel never lies about it.
negative: 3d render, cgi, octane render, unreal engine, blender, ray traced, digital art, illustration, painting, drawing, sketch, cartoon, anime, concept art, matte painting, airbrushed
plastic skin, waxy skin, rubbery skin, porcelain skin, doll-like, mannequin, uncanny valley, lifeless eyes, dead eyes, smoothed skin, beauty filter, face retouching
over-saturated, HDR, oversharpened, halo artifacts, excessive clarity, heavy vignette, bloom, glow, lens flare, chromatic aberration, teal and orange grade, instagram filter, heavy colour grade
stock photo look, corporate handshake cliche, fake smile, staged posing, thumbs up, pointing at camera, isolated on white background, generic business people
extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, six fingers, deformed hands, malformed limbs, extra limbs, extra arms, distorted anatomy, twisted joints, asymmetric face, disfigured face, mutated
text, watermark, signature, logo, lettering, caption, subtitles, ui overlay, frame, border, letterboxing
low quality, low resolution, blurry, out of focus, motion blur, jpeg artifacts, compression artifacts, banding, posterization, pixelated, oversmoothed, denoised to plastic
cluttered composition, busy distracting background, tilted horizon, cropped head, duplicated subject, cloned objects, warped perspective
harsh direct flash, blown highlights, crushed blacks, flat lifeless lighting, studio seamless backdrop
_safety_note: Medartis is a medical-device manufacturer. AI imagery that looks like clinical reality is a credibility and regulatory problem, not just a brand one. Generation is for ENVIRONMENT, ABSTRACT, TEXTURE, ARCHITECTURE and ATMOSPHERE. Clinical reality stays real photography. The server refuses any prompt matching the blocklist below; do not soften it without a decision from the brand owner.
blocklist_message: Generation is limited to environment, abstract and atmospheric imagery. Clinical content — wounds, imaging, patients or identifiable people — must be real photography or Canto, never generated. Implants and instruments may be generated as PRODUCT/ENVIRONMENT imagery, but never presented as clinical documentation.
